Suffer,Ⓒv. t.ⒹanuBU 1 P, upagam 1 P, upa-, Buj 7 A, prAp 5 P, jYA 9 U (Experience, q. v.).
Ⓑ
 2 anujYA, anuman 4 A, anumud 1 A, na pratibaMD 9 P or pratiziD 1 P.
Ⓑ
 3 vi-, sah 1 A, kzam 1 A, mfz 4 P, 10.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓ(from) kliS-tap-pIq- pass., vyaT 1 A; ‘is s(uffer)ing from an injury’ (kfta-) nikftyA pIqyate; ex. by BAj in comp., (duHKaBAk); duHKaM-pIqAM-anuBU; parArTe yaH pIqAmanuBavati ‘who s(uffer)s for others’; ‘if any important duty should not s(uffer) thereby’ yadi nAvasIdati guru prayojanaM (

) ‘a wicked person commits a fault and a good man s(uffer)s for it’ KalaH karoti durvfttiM nUnaM Palati sADuzu.
Ⓝ[Suffer]ance,Ⓒs.ⒹanujYA, anumati f., kzamA.
Ⓝ[Suffer]er,Ⓒs.ⒹduHKitaH, duHKaBAk, duHKI.
Ⓝ[Suffer]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹpIqA, kleSaH, duHKaM, vyaTA, pari-, saM-, tApaH, vedanA, kfcCraM.
Ⓑ
 2 duHKAnuBavaH-vedanaM &c.
Ⓔa.Ⓓklizwa, duHKaBAk-BAgin.

Suffice,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓkxp 1 A (with dat.). paryApta a. BU 1 P; See below; ‘s(uffice) it to say’ iti kaTanaM paryAptaM Bavet.
ⓃSufficient,Ⓒa.ⒹparyApta, upayukta, ucita, samarTa, gen. by alaM (with dat.). ‘this (cow) will be s(ufficient) to satisfy my hunger’ tasyAla-mezA kzuDitasya tfptyE (R. ii. 39), kzuDA-SAMtaye kalpeta, paryAptA Bavet.
Ⓑ
 2 yaTezwa, pracura, vipula; ‘you cannot do him s(ufficient) honour’ tadvizaye aparyAptirbahumAnasya.
Ⓝ[Sufficient]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹparyAptaM, yaTezwaM, pracuraM.
ⓃSufficiency,Ⓒs.ⒹparyApti f., OcityaM, yaTezwatA.
Ⓑ
 2 svaSaktyaBi-mAnaH.

Suffocate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSvAsaM-kaMWaM-ruD 7 U or staMB 9 P; See Choke.
Ⓝ[Suffocat]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹrudDaSvAsa-prARa-kaMWa.
Ⓝ[Suffocat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹSvAsa-prARa-roDaH, kaMWastaMBanaM.

Suffuse,Ⓒv. t.ⒹA-pari-plu c., vyAp 5 P, vyaS 5 A, A-saM-kF 6 P; ‘eyes s(uffus)ed with tears’ bAzpaparipluta-aSruplAvita-bAzpa-samAkula-nayane; ‘s(uffus)ed with blushes’ hrIparigata; savrIqa, vrIqAvilakza.
Ⓝ[Suffus]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹAplAvaH-vanaM, vyApanaM.
